provenance.author: this repository
provenance.method: slice-and-lift: none of the 30 rank-4 decompositions of |H>^4 up to symmetry extends to |H>^5

compute.hardware: Apple silicon laptop, four workers at low priority under a load average near 12: 1649 s for the enumeration and lift

notes: chi(H^4) = 4 exactly (Lean tensor-square witness and the rank-3 exclusion over 36720 states). A rank-4 decomposition of |H>^5 sliced along one qubit has slice 0 a rank-4 decomposition of |H>^4 and slice 1 a Pauli image of it, term by term, times a fourth root of unity. |H>^4 has 30 rank-4 decompositions up to its unitary symmetries (group of order 384, 246 pivot orbits) and no Pauli assignment satisfies the slice-1 equation for any of them. Bravyi, Smith, and Smolin's rank-6 decomposition is the upper bound, so the cell is 5 <= chi <= 6; whether chi(H^5) is 5 or 6 is open, and a rank-5 witness would give exponent log2(5)/5 = 0.464. The certificate declares the 3600 s budget: the qubit H-type symmetry group is small and the enumeration ran 1649 s on four loaded cores.
